bandit.disclaimer: NON-CAUSAL SIMULATION NOTICE: Payment probabilities and expected collection rewards are estimated on synthetic historical episodes using off-policy evaluation (IPS, SNIPS, Doubly Robust) and a synthetic response model. They demonstrate algorithmic policy optimization mechanics and DO NOT prove real-world causal effectiveness. Randomized field experiments (A/B testing) are required prior to autonomous production rollout.
